gate.why: compared against the branch-coverage baseline, which is MEASURED to run at one transaction; running deeper than the thing being compared to is not a comparison

artefact.why: no second party to match, so the question is what this method can REACH. tx>=2 is the only configuration measured to reach cross-function state at all

gate.why: transferFrom is a disabled ERC20 entry in St1inch and always reverts after the non-payable ABI gate. The constructor initializes immutables and voting-power state that the unit does not read, and prior no-fixture path coverage spent the budget in solver unknowns. The fixture skips deployment for ESBMC while keeping valid constructor metadata for Foundry replay.

foundry.why: Foundry cannot install St1inch runtimeCode directly because the contract has immutables. For replay only, deploy with a constructor value in the Solidity-checked valid expBase interval, then run the disabled entry.
